## Appeal Letter

Dear Summit Insurance Group,

I am writing to appeal the denial of claim #CLM-2024-01245 for services rendered on February 20, 2024. [S1]

The denial cites a code pairing issue between CPT 99214 (Office Visit, Level 4) and CPT 93000 (Electrocardiogram). These codes are routinely billed together when an ECG is performed during an evaluation and management visit. [S2]

The NCCI edit that may have triggered this denial has an applicable modifier exception. Modifier -59 applies here as the ECG was a distinct and separate service from the E&M visit. [S3]

We request reconsideration and reprocessing of this claim.

Sincerely,
Maria Gonzalez

summary.explanation: Your claim was denied due to a code pairing issue — the insurer's system flagged CPT 99214 and CPT 93000 as unbundled codes. This is a coding error denial, not a question of medical coverage. These codes are legitimately billable together when the ECG is a separate, distinct service. Modifier -59 resolves the NCCI edit.

## Appeal Letter

Dear Summit Insurance Group,

I am writing to appeal the denial of claim #CLM-2024-01245 for services rendered on February 20, 2024. [S1]

The denial cites a code pairing issue between CPT 99214 (Office Visit, Level 4) and CPT 93000 (Electrocardiogram). These codes are routinely billed together when an ECG is performed during an evaluation and management visit. [S2]

The NCCI edit that may have triggered this denial has an applicable modifier exception. Modifier -59 applies here as the ECG was a distinct and separate service from the E&M visit. [S3]

We request reconsideration and reprocessing of this claim.

Sincerely,
Maria Gonzalez

S1.text: Claims must be submitted using CMS-1500 with valid CPT codes as published in the current AMA CPT codebook.

S2.text: When an ECG is performed as a component of a separately identifiable E&M service, both codes may be billed with appropriate modifier.

S3.text: Modifier -59 is used to identify procedures or services not normally reported together but appropriately billed under the circumstances described.
